analysis.title: Advance Auto Parts Inc. (AAP): First Take: 3Q26 comp miss, but adj. EPS beat consensus expectations; FY26 outlook narrowed
key_insights: AAP reported 3Q26 adj. EPS of $0.79, below the GS estimate of $0.84 but above FactSet consensus of $0.77.
Sales fell 1.2% y/y to $2.012bn, below GS ($2.029bn) and consensus ($2.039bn). Comparable store sales fell 1.2% y/y versus GS -0.5% and consensus -0.1%.
Adj. operating margin rose 10bps y/y to 4.5% as adj. SG&A fell 26bps y/y to 40.2% of sales, offsetting a 16bps y/y decline in adj. gross margin to 44.7%.
Adj. gross margin of 44.7% was below the GS estimate of 45.0%. Adj. operating margin of 4.5% matched GS and was above consensus of 4.2%.

Management narrowed FY26 guidance: net sales ~$8.500bn (from $8.485bn-$8.575bn), comp sales ~1.0% (from 1.0%-2.0%), adj. operating margin 4.0%-4.3% (from 3.8%-4.5%), adj. EPS $2.75-$3.10 (from $2.60-$3.30).
Management raised FY26 free cash flow guidance to ~$150mn from ~$100mn, with capex unchanged at $300mn.
Free cash flow was -$11mn versus -$76mn a year earlier. Cash from operating activities rose to $59mn from -$12mn.
The accounts payable to inventory ratio fell to 80.9% from 81.3% in the prior quarter and 86.0% a year earlier.
GS expects a negative stock reaction because same-store sales were softer than expected.
GS reiterates Sell with a 12-month price target of $40 against a $50.75 price (4 Nov close), implying 21.2% downside.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 comp sales missed GS and consensus estimates. GS expects a negative reaction and sees 21.2% downside to its $40 target.

earnings_insights: AAP 3Q26 adj. EPS reported $0.79 vs GS estimate $0.84 and FactSet consensus $0.77 (reported 5 Nov 2026); 3Q25 EPS was $0.92.
AAP 3Q26 net sales reported $2.012bn vs GS estimate $2.029bn and consensus $2.039bn; comp sales -1.2% y/y vs GS estimate -0.5% and consensus -0.1%.
AAP 3Q26 adj. gross margin reported 44.7% vs GS estimate 45.0% and consensus 44.8%. Adj. EBIT reported $91mn (4.5% margin) vs GS estimate $90mn and consensus $86mn (4.2% margin).
AAP FY26 guidance narrowed: adj. EPS $2.75-$3.10 (from $2.60-$3.30), adj. operating margin 4.0%-4.3%, comps ~1.0%, FCF raised to ~$150mn. GS FY26E EPS is $2.99.
GS 3Q26 net income reported $48mn vs GS estimate $52mn; share count 60.9mn.
risk_factors: Upside risks to the Sell call: better-than-expected same-store sales driven by DIFM share gains and a DIY recovery.
Upside risks: faster expense reduction giving better margins and a clearer path to sustainable margin recovery.
Upside risks: substantial progress on turnaround or supply chain initiatives.
Upside risks: deleveraging through operational improvements and debt reduction.
